narrative.overview: Setlist looks like a clean training notebook: a pale page, white cards laid on it, and the numbers of each set written plainly. Nothing decorates the work. The lifter's data is the content, and the interface stays out of its way. The system is small and came with the assignment: Tailwind's slate neutrals, the system sans-serif, white cards with a hairline border and the faintest shadow, and one brand color, Chalk Rust, used for the main action and the logo. Components are plain and dependable: gently rounded corners, minimal shadow, no effects. They feel like a tool, not a showcase. New screens extend this world; they don't reinvent it.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (Chalk Rust) on a cool slate-and-white ground
System sans-serif, two weights doing most of the work (500 and 600)
Flat white cards with a 1px hairline and shadow-sm
Rows inside cards sit on a pale slate fill, not on dividers
lucide-react line icons at 16px beside labels

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Chalk Rust is the only saturated color on a normal screen. It marks the primary action, the focus ring, and selection; it never fills a card, a header, or a background region.

rules.name: The Two Grays Rule
rules.body: The layout and pages use slate; the form primitives (button, input, select) use gray. This split is the incumbent state. Keep each primitive on the gray it already uses, and use slate for everything new outside those primitives.

rules.name: The Small Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy is 14px (text-sm). Hierarchy comes from weight (500/600) and color (ink vs. muted), not from more sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: One elevation level exists: the card. Don't stack shadows, add hover lifts, or introduce a second, deeper shadow for new surfaces. A dialog may sit above the page with a scrim, but its panel is still a card.

dos: Do build new screens from src/components/ui/ (Button, Card, Input, Select, Alert) before writing new markup.
Do open every page with a text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900 headline and put its main action at the right of the same row.
Do put content in white cards on the slate-50 ground, and put repeated items inside a card as slate-50 rows with 8px gaps.
Do use Chalk Rust only for the primary action, links, focus, selection, and data that needs one highlight color.
Do use lucide-react icons at 16px (w-4 h-4) beside text.
Do show the pointer cursor on everything clickable: buttons, links, selects, checkboxes, radios, and <summary>. Text fields and textareas keep the text cursor.
Do write UI copy with the terms in CONTEXT.md and show weights in pounds.
donts: Don't introduce a new font, a second accent color, gradients inside the app, or dark surfaces.
Don't add shadows deeper than shadow-sm or hover lifts.
Don't change the radius steps (8px controls, 12px cards).
Don't fill a card, header, or page region with Chalk Rust.
